title: Resources and Evaluations for Multi-Distribution Dense Information Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating dense retrievers on multi-distribution datasets (e.g., Wikipedia vs. Enron emails, Walmart vs. Amazon) with queries that require retrieving an equal number of passages from each distribution, in order to measure whether the model disproportionately over-retrieves from the distribution seen during training while under-retrieving from unseen distributions.
